title: Annual Leave Application Form
text:

NOTES:
1. All the Heads of sections to have Leave Roasters in place to facilitate easy flow of officers proceeding on leave. The roaster should show the period and the days applied for.
2. Officers to fill in the leave form in DUPLICATE and submit the same to Secret Registry, a month prior to commencement of leave.
3. Leave allowance is payable only once in every 12 months. Any leave carried forward in excess of half entitlement days will be automatically be forfeited, i.e. more than 15 days for 30.
4. Staff members who take Maternity Leave will still benefit from their Annual Leave days for that year.
5. Employees who fail to return to office after attending hospital or fail to report to work due to sickness must produce a medical certificate (sick off), or else the day will be deemed as an absence and
 same recovered from the salary. This has to be within 24 hours so as to qualify for sick leave.
6. Officers on STUDY LEAVE will not be entitled to Annual Leave for the period of study.
7. Officers are required to keep records of their leave days.
